The game contains plenty of maps and allow you to play either against computer AI or against your friends in hot-seat multiplayer.

Game Features
• Fantasy turned based strategy
• Detailed tactical battles
• Four distinct races of elves, orcs, dwarfs and undeads
• 30 different units and 8 playable heroes
• Cunning AI to outsmart
• Hot-seat multiplayer
• Tens of spells and special abilities
• Stunning fairy tale graphics
• No microtransaction
